meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

copy.tagline: 审核并指导GeoPandas空间数据处理流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用GeoPandas处理地理空间数据并需要质量保障。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and guide GeoPandas spatial data workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with GeoPandas for geospatial data and need quality assurance.

howto.what: 安装技能后，Claude能指导你使用GeoPandas库处理地理空间数据，包括读写矢量文件、执行空间分析（如缓冲区、空间连接）、坐标转换、地图可视化等，并给出代码示例。
howto.when: 当你询问地理空间数据分析、矢量数据处理或GeoPandas库的使用时，Claude会自动提供指导和代码。

say.text: 帮我用GeoPandas读取一个shapefile并显示前几行。
say.note: Claude会生成读取和预览数据的代码。

say.text: 如何对两个GeoDataFrame做空间连接？
say.note: Claude会讲解sjoin用法并给出示例。

say.text: 用GeoPandas创建一个缓冲区分析并出图。
say.note: Claude会提供完整工作流代码。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can guide you in using GeoPandas for geospatial data processing, including reading/writing vector files, spatial operations (buffer, spatial join), coordinate transformation, and map visualization, with code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about geospatial data analysis, vector data handling, or using the GeoPandas library.

say_en.text: Help me read a shapefile with GeoPandas and display the first few rows.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code to read and preview data.

say_en.text: How do I perform a spatial join between two GeoDataFrames?
say_en.note: Claude will explain sjoin with examples.

say_en.text: Create a buffer analysis with GeoPandas and plot it.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a complete workflow.
